name: pe-sieve
description: Scans a given process. Recognizes and dumps a variety of potentially malicious implants (replaced/injected PEs, shellcodes, hooks, in-memory patches).

name: hollows_hunter
description: Scans all running processes. Recognizes and dumps a variety of potentially malicious implants (replaced/implanted PEs, shellcodes, hooks, in-memory patches).

name: bddisasm
description: bddisasm is a fast, lightweight, x86/x64 instruction decoder.  The project also features a fast, basic, x86/x64 instruction emulator, designed specifically to detect shellcode-like behavior.

name: win-MemoryModule
description: A flexible PE loader, loading module in memory. Most of the functions can be inline, compatible for shellcode.

name: Eggvoke
description: Eggvoke will help you create custom Egghunters for exploit development on Windows
